before.name: Alfred Hjelm
before.description: Alfred Hjelm was a Swedish-born homesteader and United Farmers’ League activist in the Westby area on the North Dakota–Montana border. After farmers used a “penny sale” to prevent the foreclosure of Victor Nielsen’s farm, a U.S. marshal arrested Hjelm and five other organizers on January 26, 1935 for conspiracy to defraud the federal government. A federal judge dismissed the defective indictment but kept the defendants under bond pending possible reindictment. The reviewed accounts do not establish that Hjelm was jailed after his arrest.
